name: mirage
text: Parlay check 09:07: 861 quotes, 2 won. Found why: when a quoted parlay did trade (8 times), it went to another maker 6-28 s later at a price 0.1-0.4 points below ours, so speed isn't the problem, price is. Across the 598 trades we can compare, the market pays a median 1.07 points over our fair. Lowered our floor from 1.0 to about 0.7 points over fair (min margin 1.5%). That should win roughly 40% of the parlays we can price, at a thin edge, so the $20 daily loss stop stays and I will revert if the result goes negative.
